resources.name: Wurtzite ZnO crystal structure and lattice parameters

access.notes: Standard wurtzite ZnO structure; the paper reports DFT-optimized lattice constants a=3.184 Å, c=5.111 Å. The crystal structure is publicly known and does not require a download.
Any open-source DFT code that supports spin-polarized LSDA/LDA and PAW pseudopotentials. Quantum ESPRESSO is a suitable replacement for the proprietary VASP used in the paper.

resources.name: PAW pseudopotentials for Zn, O, C (e.g., Pslibrary)

access.notes: Spin-polarized LSDA pseudopotentials from the Pslibrary are compatible with Quantum ESPRESSO. Use appropriate hardness and valence configurations.
Optional; pip install ase or pymatgen. Useful for constructing supercells and manipulating atomic coordinates.
